name: login
note: a typed username with a quote, and a typed password that must never show
setup_js: (() => { const set = (s, v) => { const e = document.querySelector(s); e.value = v; e.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true})); }; set('#username', 'tom"smith'); set('#password', 'ParityPassword-7f3c'); })()

name: webform
note: text, password, textarea with a line break, select, a served-checked box unchecked, a radio, a range
setup_js: (() => { const set = (s, v) => { const e = document.querySelector(s); e.value = v; e.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true})); e.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', {bubbles: true})); }; set('#my-text-id', 'notte bench'); set('input[name=my-password]', 'ParityPassword-7f3c'); set('textarea[name=my-textarea]', 'line one\nsaid "hi" <b>'); set('select[name=my-select]', '2'); document.querySelector('#my-check-1').click(); document.querySelector('#my-check-2').click(); document.querySelector('#my-radio-2').click(); set('input[name=my-range]', '7'); })()

name: apg-toolbar-bold
note: toggle buttons (aria-pressed) and a select, scrolled into view and changed
setup_js: (() => { const t = document.querySelector('[role=toolbar]'); t.scrollIntoView({block: 'start'}); t.querySelector('.bold, [value=bold], button[aria-pressed]').click(); })()

name: apg-combobox
note: a combobox (aria-expanded), scrolled into view and changed
setup_js: (() => { const c = document.querySelector('#cb1-input'); c.scrollIntoView({block: 'start'}); c.value = 'Or'; c.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true})); c.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keyup', {key: 'r', bubbles: true})); })()
